 Players have found a way to launch Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 a day before release. 
 Maxim Boldson 
 GAMES 
 November 02, 2026 
 Views: 11397 
 Detailed instructions for gaining early access to the crime action game Grand Theft Auto VI on the PlayStation 5 console have appeared online. The proposed scheme takes advantage of time zone differences and the standard regional policy of the PlayStation Network digital service, where new titles open for download and play at midnight local time in the selected country. Due to its geographic location, New Zealand is one of the first countries on the planet to experience the new calendar day, allowing users to launch the game significantly ahead of its global launch. Players in North America gain up to 18 hours, while European players gain access approximately 10-14 hours earlier than their local schedule.
 The technical implementation of the method consists of several successive steps:
 Create a new PlayStation Network account with the New Zealand region selected.
 Go to your console settings by going to Settings > Users and accounts > Other > Console sharing and offline play, and then enable this option.
 Purchase a PlayStation Network New Zealand digital gift card from the online store.
 Top up your wallet and purchase Grand Theft Auto VI using the New Zealand account you created.
 Once access is granted, download the game from your New Zealand account and switch to your main profile.
 Launch a project on your main profile without needing to continue using your New Zealand account.
 Start the game at midnight New Zealand time, getting up to 18 hours ahead of your regional schedule.
 The key feature of this method is the ability to launch the game from the player's primary personal profile without risking personal data loss. The console's sharing feature makes the purchased digital copy of Grand Theft Auto VI available to all local accounts on the device. Players don't need to spend time on the New Zealand profile after downloading the files, as the game unlocks at midnight New Zealand time and immediately launches on the original account, preserving all achievements and save files.
